page.overview:
Who is Cliff Griffith?

Cliff Griffith (born 6 February 1916 and died 23 January 1996) was an American racecar driver who entered seven Indianapolis 500 races between to while the race was a part of the Formula One championship. He finished within the top ten in both of the races he managed to complete.
